mount_point.description: Directory where the MTP device will be mounted; must exist and be writable by the user.

use_fuse.description: Enable the FUSE wrapper to expose the MTP device as a filesystem for instant file access.

use_zerocopy.description: Enable USB zerocopy support, reducing user/kernel data copying for improved performance on recent kernels.

rename_album_covers.description: Automatically rename album cover files (e.g., 'cover.jpg', 'AlbumArt.jpg') to 'albumart.jpg' for media player compatibility.
